0022600009.text: The Rockets, 1-0 and first in the Southwest, make their second trip of the season to a San Antonio side that is 0-1 and fourth in the division, one game back, while the Spurs sit 10th in the West. Houston is without Reed Sheppard (out, knee bruise), and San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance (out, knee surgery) and Tobias Harris (out, calf strain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Rockets lost the season series 1-3, including a 145-120 loss in San Antonio on March 8, 2026.
